test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Sujal is a good runner who walked 8 km towards the north from point A. He then turned around and started running back at the speed of 6 km/hour. How far would Sujal be from point A after running for 10 minutes?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance walked towards north = 8 km

Running speed = 6 km/hour

Running time = 10 minutes

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Convert time into hours:

⇒ 10 minutes = (10)/(60) hours

⇒ (1)/(6) hour

Calculate the distance covered while running:

⇒ Distance = 6 × (1)/(6)

⇒ Distance = 1 km

Initial position after walking north = 8 km

After running back 1 km towards A:

⇒ Distance from A = 8 - 1

⇒ Distance = 7 km

**∴ Sujal would be 7 km away from point A.**
